Your Shipping Needs Met

At MSC we pride ourselves on being a global container shipping company that delivers tailored solutions designed to meet the specific needs of each of our customers. Regardless of your cargo type, or final destination, we offer versatile solutions that cover air, land, and sea.

Thanks to the extensive capacity of our container fleet, MSC is the trusted transportation partner and shipping company for numerous companies the world over. Combining this with our global port coverage and extensive equipment availability means, we are able to deliver a professional, efficient shipping service, tailored to the specific needs of your business.

Agriculture

With global sourcing an everyday reality, MSC connects the growers, farmers and producers of agricultural products around the world with their key markets.

Read more

Fruit

Whether you’re shipping apples or avocados, our world-leading reefer fleet is equipped with the technology you need to keep your fruit in perfect condition. We use the Cold Treatment process as a chemical-free way to disinfect your fruit and protect it from pests.

Read more

Pharmaceuticals

More and more pharmaceutical companies are turning to sea transport to deliver medicines and other essential goods quickly and safely to the places where they are needed.
When shipping with MSC you benefit not only from our GDP compliant practices but also from our vast global network, which connects all of the world’s major trading centres. We can provide reliable and cost-effective deliveries to any destination.

Read more

Car Parts

Whether you are shipping production or service parts, a reliable and experienced shipping partner is a vital link in your uninterruptible supply chain. As the automotive industry gradually moves into a new, greener era, MSC will be here to provide the fast, flexible and transparent supply chain solution you need.

Read more

Mining & Minerals

For decades MSC has been successfully connecting the minerals extraction industries with
customer markets around the world – offering fast transit times across all key trade lanes.

Read more

Plastics & Rubber Products

Transported to and from every major trade lane, plastic and rubber goods are at the very centre of most modern global supply chains. Plastic and rubber comes in all shapes and sizes, from raw materials to finished items. MSC ship plastics, natural rubber and rubber products all around the world.

Read more

Chemicals & Petrochemicals

MSC provides careful, precise and robust processes to safely transport hazardous and dangerous goods, such as chemicals and petrochemicals. As experts in the transportation of dangerous cargoes, MSC can ensure your cargo is shipped safely and in compliance with relevant regulations. We can also help you to deal with any contingency wherever you are shipping around the globe.

Read more

Food & Beverages

Thanks to its decades of experience servicing the food and beverage industries, MSC understands the unique needs of the sector, including the importance of global port coverage, equipment availability and reliable scheduling.

Read more

Pulp, Paper & Forestry Products

Using our knowledge in transportation and logistics we can provide versatile solutions for your pulp, paper and forest products.
Our expertise covers importing and exporting paper products, including cardboard and packaging materials. Exporting timber, logs, firewood, pulp, plywood and wooden products (including prefabricated houses) is easy with MSC.

Read more

Retail

Retailers rely on efficient global product sourcing and a flexible and robust “just-in-time” supply chain. We provide seamless port-to port delivery for retailers of all sizes. We have decades of experience and expertise in worldwide retail shipments

Read more

Moving the World, Together.

Our global shipping network is developed for our customers. By focusing on delivering best-in-class service to our customers, we are always available to help you with your particular needs and offer you a one-stop-shop solution for your next shipping request.

From selecting the right container for your goods, to loading safely and efficiently at the portside, to monitoring the condition of your container throughout its time at sea, we will support you at every step of your cargo’s journey.

All Types of Commodities

From what we eat to the cars we drive and everyday items, MSC helps a huge range of industries move goods overseas. We have shipped almost every kind of cargo over more than 50 years. We have grown experience in how to load, store and deliver different kinds of items by ocean transport, along with a comprehensive knowledge of port operations.

All Types of Containers

Our fleet of vessels can hold different types of containers for different kinds of cargo. Our dry cargo containers move goods that can be shipped in a container without the need for any specialized features. We transports refrigerated and frozen goods all over the world, with one of the largest and most advanced reefer container fleets in the world. You can choose from a wide range of container types, such as 20’, 40’, high cube, open top and collapsible for your breakbulk cargo depending on your needs.

Sea Freight Specialists for Over 50 Years

With decades of experience in our core business – moving containers of goods across the world’s oceans, making sure they are syncronised with inland connections and intermodal transport, when you book with us, you can be sure of a high quality sea freight service.

Tailored Dry Cargo Shipping Solutions

From coal and clothing to cashew nuts and computers, dry cargo covers a variety of commodities all of which need to be transported with the utmost care and attention.

At MSC, we have worked to develop our dry cargo shipping solutions and maintain equipment to ensure the safe and efficient transport of your dry containerized cargo. For you as a business, this means you will be working with a shipping partner who has the size and scale to support you with solutions designed to meet the needs of your supply chain. From door-to-door logistics support, inland transportation or advice on a specific type of dry cargo container, our team has the experience to find the right approach for you.

The Benefits of Shipping your
Dry Cargo with MSC

Global Network, Local Presence

With 50 years of experience and the extensive capacity of our global fleet, we are market leaders in shipping dry cargo worldwide. Our network covers over 300 routes and 520 ports across 155 countries, helping you reach your core markets.

Enjoy consistent and reliable service thanks to the scale of our operations.

Find your local MSC office today.

Specialized Dry Cargo Containers

Alongside our range of shipping solutions, partnering with MSC for your dry cargo shipping means you’ll have access to a range of specialized container types. Whether you need a 20’ or 40’ standard container, or a 40’ high steel cube container, we can support you in finding the right equipment for the job.

Complete Supply Chain Support

Caring for your whole supply chain, we offer a range of digital and inland solutions which provide you with the insight and support you need to successfully transport your cargo worldwide. Beyond this, our strong cargo cover solutions are designed to protect your dry cargo goods during transit for a seamless and carefree shipping experience.

Ship Your Dry Cargo Sustainably

At MSC, we are committed to accelerating decarbonization in the shipping industry. That’s why we have developed MSC Biofuel Solution to help you reduce the carbon footprint of your shipments, enabling more sustainable operations and contributing to your environmental goals.

Estimate the CO2e emissions of your dry cargo shipments with our Carbon Footprint Calculator, understand the environmental impact of your supply chain and calculate the CO2e emission reduction you can achieve by choosing MSC Biofuel Solution.

Expertise Across Diverse Dry Cargo Commodities & Industries

Whether you’re shipping paper, scrap metal, hazardous, food-grade, or precious cargo, by partnering with MSC for your dry cargo shipments you can rest assured that your cargo is in the best hands possible.

Our Standard Use Shipping Containers

We offer a range of standard use containers, ideal for shipping a range of dry cargo products. This allows your cargo to be efficiently moved across different transportation types, without needing to be unloaded or reloaded. So, whether your cargo is travelling by road, rail, ocean, or a combination of these, once it’s been packed, you can rest assured that your container will remain sealed, and your goods will be safely protected at all times.

Commonly Asked Questions About Shipping Dry Cargo

What is dry cargo?

Dry cargo refers to goods that are shipped in solid, non-liquid form and do not require temperature control. These goods are typically transported in standard shipping containers and include everything from manufactured products to raw materials.

What is the difference between dry bulk and dry container shipping?

The key difference lies in how the cargo is handled and transported:

Dry bulk shipping involves transporting loose, unpackaged commodities directly in a ship’s hold. It is ideal for large volumes of uniform goods like coal or grain.

Dry container shipping involves packing goods into containers (typically 20ft or 40ft units). It is suited for smaller, packaged, or mixed cargo such as consumer goods, machinery, or textiles.

Discover the Ideal Conditions for Transporting Different Types of Refrigerated Cargo

Keeping refrigerated cargo fresh depends not only on the temperature inside the container, but also humidity control and fresh-air circulation.

What is the recommended temperature for reefer containers? Different cargoes require different conditions; for example, blueberries are usually carried at -1°C, while bananas can remain fresh at 12-13.5°C. To learn more about the recommended conditions for specific cargo, download our reefer cargo stuffing guide.

Temperature

Each product has an optimum storage temperature which is the ideal condition for transportation. Generally, this is the coolest temperature a product can withstand before chilling or freeze injury occurs.

Chilling injury

Physiological damage can occur to tropical and subtropical products which have been exposed to low but non-freezing temperatures. The most common example is the browning of banana skins. Often the damage only becomes visible when the product is returned to ‘room temperature’.

Freeze injury

Products that can withstand cold temperatures can still become damaged when they reach freezing point. This occurs when the cellular structure of the product is ruptured by the expansion of water during the freezing process. It can cause products to appear water-soaked with damaged structures.

Humidity

Humidity levels play a crucial role in achieving the optimum condition for cargo during transit. MSC’s world-leading reefer fleet features cutting-edge dehumidification technology, helping to protect fresh produce from shrivelling or excessive water loss. Please note that the services we provide can only reduce humidity; we cannot increase humidity levels within the container.

Ventilation

Ventilation protects chilled commodities from damage caused by a build-up of carbon dioxide and ethylene. If too much carbon dioxide accumulates inside the container, the internal tissues of products such as pears and apples may become discoloured. Ethylene is a hormone produced by all fruits, vegetables and flowers. Although it is necessary for the ripening process of fruit, it can damage other cargo such as green vegetables. MSC’s reefer units are fitted with vents to allow fresh air to circulate freely, without letting in too much moisture.

Packing Refrigerated Cargo

To keep your reefer cargo in the best possible condition throughout its journey, simply follow the steps bellow.

Palletized loads of refrigerated cargo must be stackable up to a height of 2.4 metres.

The material used for packaging must also be able to withstand moisture and allow vertical airflow through boxes in order to maintain the correct temperature.

The corners of boxes must be securely supported by the pallet.

The stack of boxes must be accurately aligned to ensure each box is supported at all four corners.

Air vents in boxes must be aligned to allow for the easy flow of air without restrictions.

The Perfect Temperature for your  Refrigerated Goods

Ahead of transportation, pre-cool your goods to achieve optimal temperature levels before loading them into a container. This will reduce the impact of outside temperatures on your valuable products while they are on the move. It's important to note that there is currently no technology available to prevent or reverse the ageing of perishable goods, but our reefer technology helps to slow down this process and maximize the shelf life of your cargo.

Three key factors impact the temperature of products during transportation:

Outside temperatures entering the container during loading and unloading

The temperature of the product itself prior to loading

Ventilation inside the container.

Follow These Simple Steps to Maximize the Shelf Life of your Cargo

Packing your reefer container correctly helps protect your cargo and keep it in the best possible condition throughout its journey. It’s particularly important to allow air to flow freely around and between products to maintain a consistent temperature. The best way to load your cargo depends on the type of commodity and the packaging you are using. How to stuff your reefer container:

There are two recommended patterns to follow when loading your reefer cargo:

block stowage and

palletized stowage.

Did you Know?

As a general rule, pre-cooled frozen cargoes only require free-flowing air to circulate around the product, whereas chilled commodities such as fresh fruit and vegetables require air to flow through the cargo. This is because chilled products produce respiratory heat which needs to be removed to avoid damage to cargo due to temperature change.

Your Reefer-shipping Checklist

Load cargo up to the edge of the T-floor, to ensure an even flow of air around the container.

When there is not enough cargo to fill the entire T-floor, we recommend using a filler or dunnage to cover the vacant area. This can also be used to cover the centre panel between pallets where there is empty space.

As an exception, appropriately pre-cooled frozen cargo can be loaded as per the third image, but appropriate bracing would be required.
When using palletised stowage, we recommend that the last cargo loaded into the container should be covered to encourage airflow through the cargo and prevent air from escaping through the open space around the boxes.

Never load cargo beyond the red load line of the container or the end of the T-floor.

Keeping your Frozen Cargo in Top Condition

How to transport frozen goods? Making sure that your frozen cargo arrives at its destination in pristine condition is an exacting process. With years of experience in transporting frozen cargoes all over the world, MSC has a deep knowledge of recommended commodity conditions, loading procedures and local port facilities. We’re here to make the process of shipping your frozen goods as simple and efficient as possible.

When transporting frozen products, it is crucial that cargo inside the container forms a solid block without spaces between boxes and the walls of the unit. This allows air to freely circulate evenly around the load maintaining a steady temperature for your goods.

The cargo must be pre-frozen to the correct temperature.

Maximum load height should never exceed the red load line of the container.

Ventilation of the container must always remain closed and humidity off.

Packaging must be able to resist moisture and allow for a vertical flow through boxes to maintain the correct temperature.

Thinking Outside the Box: Smart Solutions for Oversized Cargo

We understand that not all cargo fits inside a standard container and that oversized cargo requires special handling and care. Whether you need to ship heavy machinery, luxury yachts, helicopters, or turbines, our project cargo team can create safe, secure, and competitive logistics solutions for all types of special cargo.

At MSC we have over 50 years of experience shipping goods of all shapes and sizes across the world. With a team of experts by your side, you can rest assured that your project cargo shipment will be planned down to the last detail and delivered most efficiently. Due to the specialist nature of project cargo, we consider each out-of-gauge and breakbulk shipment on a case-by-case basis, tailoring our solutions around your unique requirements to deliver your cargo to any destination.

Remove the challenge and stress of shipping oversized cargo by trusting the experts at MSC.

Why Choose MSC for Project Cargo Services

Transporting project cargo starts with understanding the requirements. That’s why our team will always have a detailed discussion with you before we start working on your bespoke project cargo solution. This ensures we fully understand the needs of your shipment before work begins.

Unique Breakbulk Solutions

On board vessels, we store your cargo on a pre-prepared bed containing multiple flat racks, providing a safe working environment for stevedores and ensuring compliance with IMO CSS Code Annex 13 requirements. As part of our feasibility studies and preparation, we use 3D modelling to demonstrate handling stowage and lashing requirements.

Our team also focuses on loss and claim prevention for very large and/or heavy cargo, ensuring a safe and smooth delivery.

Out of Gauge Cargo

If your cargo does not fit a standard container, we will carefully load and secure (lash) it onto a platform, single flat rack or open top unit.  Our experts will work with you to create a tailor-made solution for a safe and secure delivery.  We have access to specialized equipment and handling facilities such as container lift trailers, floating cranes and cargo securing solutions.

Our project cargo solutions go beyond shipping: we also offer door-to-door deliveries by road, rail and barge.

Additional Local Solutions

In some countries, we offer additional solutions such as loading, lashing and securing cargo at your origin port or nearby depot. We can also arrange inland collection and deliveries using a variety of equipment, as well as police/inland transport notifications. Stevedoring, port lashing and port storage facilities can also be provided if required. Contact us to find out whether these options are available in your country or region.

Our experts help with the planning and execution of special loadings, ensuring maximum safety and security for each and every project.

Questions about Project Cargo?

When is Project Cargo Needed?

Project cargo is typically associated with large scale construction and maintenance projects, including oil and gas, mining, wind, and solar projects. All these industries require large, heavy, or complex pieces of machinery or equipment, which must be delivered on time and undamaged to prevent delays with the overall project.

While project cargo is frequently associated with shipping oversized or over dimensional cargo, it’s also about ensuring that all risks, delays, and potential problems are mitigated as far as possible. That’s where working with a dedicated project cargo partner like MSC can make a significant difference. We understand the requirements of planning and executing project cargo and out of gauge shipments, and our attention to detail enables us to deliver flexible, bespoke solutions for our customers.

Share
Link copied!

What are the Different Types of Project Cargo Transportation?

There are various ways to transport oversized cargo, depending on the commodity. The main forms of transportation generally include trucks, cranes, railways, planes, and of course shipments.

Because of how it is used, project cargo tends to have a specific timeframe or delivery date, meaning that it’s crucial to work with a shipping company like MSC who understand how to organize detailed, complicated logistics solutions.

Share
Link copied!

How does MSC Handle my Breakbulk Shipment?

Throughout our project cargo solution, we break each process down into smaller pieces. This way each step is meticulously designed to ensure the safe and timely delivery of your cargo. For each project, our experts will advise you on the most ideal lashings and crating. We will also ensure that any required inland transportation has been organized and follows all guidelines and safety measures.

We also understand the importance of great coordination throughout your project cargo shipment to avoid unnecessary delays. Along with our global port coverage, we will work closely with the port to make sure the right equipment is available to unload the cargo and reload correctly onboard the vessel.

Liquid Cargo FAQs

What is a flexitank - flexibag?

Used for the transportation of non-hazardous liquids, a flexibag is a hermetically sealed, collapsible, and flexible bag or bladder. Flexibags are fitted into a twenty-foot Dry Van (DV) or standard container before being filled with your liquid cargo. Once filling is complete, the flexibag is sealed and a bulkhead or a sturdy frame is used to stop it from moving inside the container.

Share
Link copied!

What are flexibags made from?

Our multilayer recyclable bags are made from food-grade virgin polyethylene film with premium woven silk and a polypropylene outer layer for extra flexibility and strength.

Share
Link copied!

What is the difference between a flexibag and a flexitank?

They are one and the same.

Share
Link copied!

Are your flexibags food-grade suitable?

Yes, our recyclable bags are made from food-grade virgin polyethylene film.

Share
Link copied!

What type of cargo can flexibags carry?

Flexibags can hold a wide range of liquid cargo, including:

- Soft drinks such as fruit juice/concentrate or mineral water

- Alcoholic beverages such as wine and flat beer

- Various types of oil, e.g., cooking oil and vegetable oil

- Non-hazardous chemicals, e.g., glycerine or lubricants

Flexibags cannot be used to carry:

- Hazardous chemicals

Share
Link copied!

Does a flexibag keep cargo fresh?

Yes, flexibags are designed to be airtight, so contents are kept fresh for the duration of their journey.

Share
Link copied!

How many flexibags can fit into a container?

One bag is used per container, maximizing the volume usage and payload per container.

Share
Link copied!

How many times can a flexibag be used?

Each flexibag is single-use and recyclable, making them the hygienic choice for shipping edible cargoes.

Share
Link copied!

How do you fill a flexibag?

Flexibags can be filled from the top or bottom, depending on the cargo being loaded and the loading installation of our customers.

Share
Link copied!

How do you transport liquid cargo?

Fit – load – go!

Top-quality flexibags are carefully secured inside containers by our in-house team at dedicated fitting stations.

Our experts then offer loading and unloading assistance at loading plant.

We keep your cargo moving with our seamless intermodal connections and global shipping solutions.

MSC experts are available at all points across the liquid cargo supply chain.

We offer complementary loading and unloading of liquid cargo while our cross-pumping service allows transfer to and from ISO tanks, flexibags, storage tanks or tank trucks.

Share
Link copied!

What is the difference between an ISO tank and flexitank?

Flexibags are generally a more flexible and cost-effective alternative to ISO tanks (cylindrical metal containers held inside a steel frame). This is because they can be installed inside any 20’ container that meets the relevant quality standards, with no need for cleaning or repositioning.

Not sure which option is best for your cargo? Speak to your local MSC team for help.

Share
Link copied!

What are the benefits of flexibag shipping solutions?

There are several benefits of flexibag shipping solutions. Flexibags are recyclable and made from food-grade virgin polyethylene film with premium woven silk and a polypropylene outer layer. Not only does this make them an environmentally friendly shipping solution, but also provides extra flexibility and strength during shipping which helps to protect your cargo.

Other benefits of flexitank shipping include:

They’re suitable for a wide range of cargo types and volumes

They’re airproof, weatherproof, and waterproof which helps preserve product quality

They aid in faster loading and unloading

Link copied!

Are MSC's liquid cargo solutions available in my country?

You can find our liquid cargo solutions at a growing number of MSC-owned depots around the world.

Our standalone network allows us to swiftly adapt to market changes, ensuring your shipping as usual, always meeting your dynamic transportation requirements.

By operating independently, we can offer you a smoother, more responsive service tailored to your needs, with faster decision-making and greater control over our space availability and vessel fleet.

Global Reach with Local Expertise

Ship cargo to anywhere in the world with confidence, knowing you will have dedicated shipping experts by your side and support in your language.

Our extensive global trade network and local teams make importing and exporting to any market seamless and efficient.

Largest Availability of Space and Equipment

Equipped with 1,000 vessels, 6.1 million TEUs of estimated capacity, and local offices in more than 155 countries, we are ready to support your business, delivering a smoother, more responsive service customized to your unique needs.

Optimized Transit Times and

Shipping Schedules

Time is critical when shipping cargo, which is why we have designed our ocean service network to provide the largest number of direct port calls. This gives you exceptional connectivity and a variety of sailing options.

With our competitive transit times, supported by frequent sailing schedules and reliable service planning, your cargo reaches its destination quickly, streamlining your shipping process for greater efficiency and reliability.

We also offer a full suite of digital solutions, including online booking, real-time tracking, and comprehensive warehousing, streamlining your logistics process for maximum efficiency.

Frequently Asked Questions

What are global trade services in shipping?

Shipping routes are established, efficient, and often regulated maritime paths used by vessels to transport goods between ports, acting as the backbone of global trade.

Shipping routes directly influence efficiency, costs, and delivery reliability, all of which have an impact on the supply chain. Well-optimized routes ensure on-time delivery, helping businesses meet customer KPIs. Efficient routes also minimize transit time, which reduces inventory holding costs and accelerates the flow of goods.

What trade routes does MSC operate?

MSC offers multiple services connecting markets worldwide. Our global network of efficient shipping services connect customers to all corners of the world, while helping to protect our oceans and respect the environment.

What types of cargo can be shipped via MSC trade services?

A plethora of commodities can and are shipped using the appropriate shipping solution from dry cargo like cocoa and furniture to frozen meat, liquid cargo and out-of-gauze project cargo.

How do I choose the best shipping route?

This does depend on the market you are trying to reach and the services offered by the carriers. However, visit our Search a Schedule page to find your ideal shipping route based on the port you want to ship to and from.

What Do we Mean by Inland Transportation?

Inland transportation refers to the movement of cargo within a country’s transport infrastructure, by road, rail, river or other inland waterway networks. It’s a key part of the supply chain, connecting ports with factories, warehouses, and final destinations. MSC’s inland logistics solutions simplify this journey. Our intermodal network is built to move your cargo seamlessly, reducing delays, handovers, and admin.

Global Network of Warehousing Facilities

We understand that the ability to store cargo and containers, whether it’s short-term container space at the port or longer-term warehousing inland, is crucial for your supply chain. That’s why we continue to invest in a global network of flexible, secure warehousing and distribution hubs. Strategically located near major ports and inland transport hubs, our facilities enable a faster turnaround, value-added services, and comprehensive cargo visibility.

Compare Our Inland Transport Options

Our inland freight solutions are built around three key pillars: flexibility, reliability, and global coverage. Whether you're moving containers across borders or need storage for your cargo, we provide a full portfolio of shipping and logistics solutions that seamlessly connect you across sea and land.

Warehousing and Storage with MSC:
The Benefits

Pauses and delays (either planned or unplanned) are a natural part of any international supply chain. Managing them effectively by using warehousing and storage services is critical.

Ensuring your goods (particularly perishables like food, beverages, or agriculture) are stored safely and in optimal conditions, helps you avoid damaging your cargo during transport. To optimize your supply chain even further, our warehousing and storage solutions are designed to easily be combined with our sea and inland transportation services, helping save you time and money.

Dry Storage Warehousing

Available around the world, our dry store warehousing network helps keep your supply chain fast, flexible, and efficient. As well as offering empty container depot solutions and off/on-dock container freight stations, in certain locations, we also offer repacking and relabelling options to help make your final delivery even easier.

To learn more, please contact your local MSC agency for further details and availability of this solution.

Cold Storage Solutions

When you’re using reefer cargo to ship temperature-sensitive cargo, our cold storage facilities help to maintain the quality and integrity of your goods even when they’re static. Not only do our temperature-controlled warehouses meet the highest standards of quality and certification, but they also offer full traceability, so you can rest assured that your cargo is in safe hands.

Contact your local agent to check availability.

Learn more

Value-added Storage and Warehousing Solutions

Our warehouse and storage solutions go beyond providing safety and security for your cargo. Other key services include picking, packing, unloading, labelling, palletization, and bulk stacking, along with cargo reception, re-packaging, and assembling. This allows us to support not just transport, but also the coordination of your distribution network.

Because Shipping is more than Just Ships

Our focus on customer care and creating bespoke solutions for your business means MSC’s warehousing and storage facilities can help you enhance your supply chain and simplify your global logistics approach.

Speak to a member of our team today about how to integrate our warehousing solutions into your existing shipping strategy.

FAQs About Warehousing

Why Warehousing
is Important?

Warehousing plays a vital role in the logistics network. It enables goods to be kept at their best while there are pauses in the transportation process – for example, at the port of departure or reception. There may be delays in shipping, whether planned or unplanned, and high-quality warehousing needs to be integrated into any flexible supply chain.

Using warehouses with the right features and technology is critical for perishable goods, food, beverages or agricultural produce that require specific conditions.

What are the three basic functions of a warehouse?

• Storage – a place to store goods

• Traceability – ensuring cargo being stored can be quickly located

• Movement – measures for shipping goods out of the warehouse needs to be quick and efficient

What features should be looked for in a warehouse?

Warehouses should be geographically convenient for your supply chain. There should be sufficient space for the volume of goods to be stored. The warehouse should have adequate integrated technology for the type of products in storage. There should be an effective management system, clear safety measures and good accessibility for traffic.

A Growing Network for
Global Coverage

From South America to India, our cold stores are strategically located near key ports to facilitate import and export flows of temperature-controlled cargo. We continue to invest in new facilities to support customers around the world and help you keep up with global demand.

State-of-the-art Cold Storage Facilities

Our cold storage solutions utilize the latest technology to preserve the quality of your cargo. For instance, at our Savannah cold store, we use blast-freezing technology to rapidly reduce the temperature of meat and preserve quality, texture and nutritional value. We also offer cutting-edge ripening systems to allow fruits such as bananas, mangoes and avocados to mature within 3-5 days, ensuring the best quality for your cargo upon arrival.

Smart Operations Focused on Safety and Efficiency

Our advanced cold chain logistics capabilities include intelligent cold storage, automated temperature control, and data-driven warehouse management systems, ensuring efficiency and product safety.

We also place a special emphasis on smart operations, such as automated handling and secure tracking, and on full compliance with customer and customs requirements to maintain effective cold chain management across your supply chain.

Because You Need More than Port-to-Port Solutions

Complementing our shipping, inland and digital solutions, our Cold Storage Solutions are designed to keep your refrigerated and frozen cargo in optimal condition throughout the supply chain.

More than just storage, our facilities offer a range of value-added services, including customs clearance, labelling and inspections, helping simplify your logistics. Benefit from greater efficiency, visibility and convenience at every stage of your shipment.

Contact your local MSC team to learn more about our Cold Storage Solutions.

FAQs

What are cold storage solutions?

Cold storage solutions are temperature-controlled storage services designed to keep perishable or sensitive goods within a specific temperature range. They are commonly used for food, pharmaceuticals, and other products that require consistent conditions to maintain quality and safety.

What types of goods require cold storage?

Cold storage is essential for products that are sensitive to temperature changes, including fresh and frozen food, dairy products, pharmaceuticals, vaccines, and certain chemicals. These solutions help preserve product integrity and extend shelf, , life throughout storage and distribution.

How do cold storage solutions support the supply chain?

Cold storage solutions support the supply chain by maintaining consistent temperature conditions, reducing the risk of spoilage or damage, and ensuring compliance with industry regulations. When integrated with transport and logistics services, they help improve efficiency, product quality, and delivery reliability.

Elevate your Supply Chain with MSC’s Digital Business Solutions

At MSC, we believe that digitalization also has the power to make shipping more efficient, secure and sustainable. We are continuously investing in developing new digital tools and technologies to provide customers with easy-to-use, flexible and reliable online shipping management solutions.

But digital transformation doesn’t stop at technology. As a founding member of the Digital Container Shipping Association (DCSA), MSC plays a leading role in shaping the future of shipping digitalization. By helping standardize data and processes across the shipping industry, we’re enabling greater collaboration and interoperability across the entire industry.

Our solutions are designed to provide you with enhanced visibility and better control of your cargo shipping experience, securely managing every step online, without losing MSC’s personal touch.

Why we Invest in Digital Supply Chain Solutions

For us at MSC, digitalization is about making shipping easier. By replacing slow, paper-based processes with streamlined online workflows, digitalization makes shipping faster, more efficient, secure, and sustainable. Our digital tools and solutions are designed to improve your entire shipping experience and support the continued movement of global trade.

Meeting your Demands

Digitalization is becoming the norm across global supply chains, and you expect an intuitive online experience as a baseline. That is why we are continually investing in our digital solutions and developing new technologies to support your business and adapt to your evolving needs. Our Digital Solutions enable contactless transactions, and access to real-time data, helping build more resilient supply chains.

Driving Sustainability

Switching to paperless processes directly reduces your supply chain’s carbon footprint, avoidable waste, and environmental impact. By embracing the intersection of sustainability and digitalization we help you unlock opportunities for growth, innovation, and future-ready operations.

Improving Security and Efficiency

The safety benefits of maritime digitalization are critical. Thanks to secure transmissions you are protected against fraud while reducing the risk of document loss. You can also minimize manual errors, speed up processing times, and increase productivity with our digital business solutions and enjoy additional cost savings.

Find out More About our Integration Suite

Answers to frequently asked questions about the MSC Integration Suite.

What are the steps to establish integration with MSC?

Integration Request: The integration request must be submitted to MSC via the request form.

MSC Internal Assessment: MSC’s integration team evaluates the request details and contacts the requestor to propose a suitable solution aligned with their needs.

Data Sharing Agreement: As part of the onboarding process, a Data Sharing Agreement must be signed to secure the integration and confirm alignment with MSC’s terms and conditions.

Connection Setup: MSC technical experts work with the requestor’s technical team to set up the connection and complete the required development activities.

Testing: MSC supports the requestor during UAT testing to ensure quality and validate all scenarios before production deployment.

Go-Live: Once testing is completed and the scope and timelines are agreed, the integration goes live with support from MSC’s technical and integration teams.

Support: After go-live, MSC provides dedicated support, to address and resolve any integration-related issues as quickly as possible.

What documentation is required to proceed with an integration?

To proceed with an integration, a Data Sharing Agreement must be signed between the parties. In the case of an integration via a Solution Provider, a Letter of Authorization (LOA) is required for each customer.

Are there any fees associated with the Integration Suite?

Integrations via third party vendors are subject to fees depending on the setup and on the Integration Package selected. Customers connecting directly to MSC are not charged.

Link copied!

How can I follow up on the status of my request?

Once your request has been submitted, our team will keep you informed about its status and will contact you if any additional information is required.

Where can I find the technical implementation guidelines supported by MSC?

All EDI and API implementation guidelines as well as sample data are available in our Developer Portal for reference. API credentials for both UAT and Production environments are provided only after the onboarding process has been completed.

Can I have multiple connections for the same company?

No, we provide one connection per customer, that can support multiple message types. Multiple connections per region are not supported.

Link copied!

Can I customize the message format for the EDI?

Our solutions are designed to address your needs while complying with the standardization best practices. As such, we do not recommend customized or non-standardized integrations.

Share
Link copied!

How many API calls are supported?

API usage is limited to 100,000 calls per day and up to 4 calls per second. These limits cannot be increased.

Link copied!

Is it possible to have hybrid integration (API and EDI)?

Yes, a hybrid setup combining API and EDI is possible. However, it is generally recommended to go for API integrations, as they are faster to implement, more flexible, and provide data availability closer to real time.

Link copied!

How’s the data availability across the EDI and API connections?

With API connections, data is available close to real time. As soon as the data is received in our systems, it becomes available.

For EDI integrations, data is processed in batch mode, meaning it becomes available according to the defined batch processing schedule.

Is there a Spot Quotes integration available?

Spot quotes are currently available only via myMSC. At this time, no API or EDI solutions are available for spot quotes.

Is there a global solution available for invoices?

At present, no global invoicing solution is available. For invoice-related matters, please contact the local MSC agency.

What if I’m using the older RSS Feed?

Please indicate that you’re a current RSS Feed (web services) customer when submitting the Integration Request Form, including the URL you use to access the information. This will help us to migrate the technical component for your new API connection.

Why can’t I find integration formats from my local office in the MSC catalogue?

The portfolio of integration formats shown in the MSC catalogue is available at global level. The MSC API and EDI solutions share information on all shipments, from different locations following the same message standards and harmonized process. Integration formats, that are managed locally, are not included in this process yet.

Manage your eBills of Lading in a Matter of Clicks!

In an increasing digitalized world, everyone wants access to data and documents online, 24/7 and from anywhere. The electronic bill of lading is an original electronic document which offers a more efficient, secure, and sustainable alternative to a complex and costly process. It has the same legal value and replicates the functions of an original BL in paper, but electronically.  No more paperwork, postage costs, delays or disruptions to move physically important trade documents between exporters, shipping agents, banks, importers and other parties.

Did you know?

Enabling paperless trade with 100% eBL adoption could save 28,000 trees per year and $6.5 billion in direct costs for stakeholders.

Why Choose eBill of Lading?

More Efficient

Transfer your eBL in minutes instead of weeks with MSC's eBL

Maximize your savings by:

Streamlining your workflows, without disrupting existing processes

Accelerating payment times

Reducing administrative workload and eliminating courier or postage fees

Safer

Our eBL solution is offered via WAVE BL's digital courier platform where all parties involved on the eBL are connected in a decentralized network, which allows them to securely exchange documents. All data is secured and encrypted by blockchain technology, and every document or signature is verified and authenticated.

This means that the risk of document loss, forgery or fraud is eliminated.

Simpler & Sustainable

Amend, endorse, surrender or transfer your eBL at any time, from anywhere, via the WAVE BL user-friendly platform. Mirroring the traditional paper-based process, electronic Bill of Lading helps reduce human errors and time-consuming processes.

With eBL you can also reduce your carbon footprint with paperless process.

Smart Containers

Knowing the Position of your Container is Just the Start...

We know that being able to track and monitor your shipment remotely helps you to plan. That's why we offer MSC smart containers for all types of dry cargo.

We equip dry units with internet connected devices that collect data such as position, temperature and door opening in real-time – helping you to make the right decisions at the right moment.

24/7 visibility of your cargo

Easy and affordable

Customizable notifications

Connect

MSC's smart container devices provide meaningful, contextualized, and timely shipment insights through the Horizon visibility platform, enabling enhanced supply chain visibility and decision-making.

Enjoy 24/7 access to data about your container's position, door status, temperature and more, whether it is on land or at sea.

Protect

When you choose our smart container solutions, you'll receive personalized alerts in case of any unexpected events during transit, such as shocks or door openings. This ensures a high level of security throughout your cargo's journey.

Care and Improve

Use the data generated by your smart containers to optimize a wide range of operations within your supply chain:

Streamline your decision-making process

Trigger contingency plans when needed

Share important updates such as delivery timings with business partners and customers

Reduce operating costs and manual work

Understand when, where and why disruptions or delays occur

MSC iReefer FAQs?

We've got you covered with some of the most frequently asked questions about MSC iReefer!

What is MSC iReefer?

MSC iReefer is a reefer container equipped with an IoT (Internet of Things) device that collects and transmit data about your shipment condition and location in real-time.

Download our brochure and learn more!

Share
Link copied!

How does MSC iReefer work?

The IoT device on the reefer unit transmits telemetry data (e.g. temperature inside the container) and GPS position via cellular networks or satellite when out of range. This ensures continuous, real-time visibility of your refrigerated cargo anywhere in the world.

Share
Link copied!

What are the benefits of MSC iReefer?

MSC iReefer provides real-time visibility into your shipment’s position, temperature, humidity and journey – reducing the risk of cargo damage or loss. It enables smarter decision-making and greater supply chain efficiency, all from one easy-to-use platform, accessible via myMSC or API.

Share
Link copied!

Is the data shown in real-time?

Yes. For our connected vessels, when powered and in range of a cellular or satellite network, the MSC iReefer units will transmit updates in near-real time, typically every hour.

Share
Link copied!

How can I purchase MSC iReefer?

You can access the MSC iReefer Essential and Pro packages through our myMSC eBusiness platform. If you already have an account, simply log in. If not, you’ll need to create one. For existing bookings, the Essentials package is free and automatically visible in your dashboard if a compatible iReefer is assigned; from there, you can upgrade to Pro.

For future shipments, contact your booking agency via your usual booking channel and request MSC iReefer. For MSC iReefer Ultimate, please contact your MSC commercial representative to discuss the implementation.

FAQs?

We are here for you!

When should I choose MSC Extended Protection instead of Marine Cargo Insurance?

Why choose when you can have both? Our Extended Protection solution may be used alongside your existing Marine Cargo Insurance solution to cover the value of your insurance deductible. By offering an additional layer of protection against cargo losses, thefts or damages, our Extended Protection services could be a valuable investment.

How long does it take to settle a claim?

With our Extended Protection solution, our dedicated claims team will process your claim in as little as 30 working days from the time your documentation is received! For our Marine Cargo Insurance solution, the claim is processed on the insurer’s timeline and requirements, but our teams will support you at every stage.

Is my cargo covered only during sea transport or also during inland transportation?

Both solutions are designed to protect your cargo door-to-door. Marine Cargo Insurance protects the inland portion whether performed by MSC or your own suppliers. MSC Extended Protection protects the inland portion only if arranged by MSC/Medlog or a subcontractor of MSC.

The Protection your Cargo Deserves

Protecting your cargo against financial losses is crucial, in events such as rough weather, fire, theft, and many other occurrences.

Available globally for a wide range of cargo including dry and refrigerated commodities, MSC Extended Protection offers you the extra level of protection you need for your cargo’s partial or full value *. Shipping fresh produce? We’ve got you covered with a dedicated cargo cover solution.

With a simple, fast-tracked claim’s resolution process and one-stop-shop approach aiming to solve claims in 30 working days from the submission of all necessary documents, protecting your cargo has never been easier. Add extended protection to your booking in a few clicks and enjoy seamless protection of your cargo’s value and the support of a dedicated team at every step of your cargo’s protection journey.

*full value is calculated based on 110% of the shipment CIF value.

One-stop-shop approach

Why Choose MSC Extended Protection?

One-stop-shop Approach to Shipping Protection

We are always by your side. This is why we designed our Extended Protection solution as a one stop shop approach that offers the benefit of a sole interlocutor throughout your journey with MSC. This approach ensures a more efficient and simpler process.

Wide Scope

Our solution is available for both spot shipments and volume contracts, worldwide. MSC Extended Protection supports a broad range of transportation solutions, including warehouse-to-warehouse and anything else in between enabling you to protect your cargo on a door-to-door basis, subject to carrier haulage.

Easy Pricing Procedure

The tariff charged for MSC Extended Protection is easily calculated, based on your cargo value and specificities. There is also the option to select partial value protection. The applicable tariff will be displayed on your freight invoice to help ensure you receive the protection your cargo deserves.

Simple Claims Process

We aim to conclude all Extended Protection claims within a 30 working-day average period, running from the submission of your completed file. To minimize the impact of the claim process we offer a straightforward procedure requiring fewer documents, with surveys conducted by MSC-appointed independent experts, a local point of contact, and dedicated support from our specialist claims team.

A Fast-tracked Claims Procedure

The handling of your cargo claims will be taken care of by MSC directly through a fast-track procedure relying on three main elements:

Easy processing

The support of a dedicated Claims team

Surveys conducted by a surveyor appointed by MSC

What is Covered with the MSC Extended Protection Solution

MSC Extended Protection covers a wide range of cargoes and offers a supplemental layer of protection for your cargo for accidental damage, loss, or theft during its journey with us.

Our extended cargo protection covers loss or damage to cargo due to:

● Fire.

● Stranding, grounding, sinking, collision.

● Heavy weather events.

● Acts of God/natural events.

● Wetting damage (hole in container roof allowing water infiltration).

● Stevedore mishandling.

● Thefts & pilferage.

● Reefers’ temperature variation (from 24 consecutive hours).

● Geopolitical events (riots; strikes; warlike operations at sea; terrorism and weapons).

Link copied!

MSC Extended Protection Solution Does not Cover

Please be aware, that our cargo protection systems do not cover loss or damage to cargo due to:

● Delays.

● Insufficient or improper packaging.

● Loss or damage attributable to the willful misconduct of the shipper, consignee, or other merchant.

● Ordinary leakage, loss in weight, wear, and tear.

● Inherent defect, quality, or vice.

● Temperature or atmospheric pressure changes.

● Other events (sanctioned countries; persons or goods; seizures or arrests; cyber-risks, and similar events).

FAQs about MSC’s Extended Cargo Protection Services

Discover more about how MSC’s Extended Protection service ensures a seamless protection experience for your cargo.

How does MSC Extended Protection Process Work in Case of Damage to your Cargo?

For any compensation request under the MSC EPR, the Merchant must follow the steps below:

1. Notify MSC on Time

Visible loss or damage: Notify MSC immediately at delivery.

Hidden loss or damage: Notify MSC within maximum 3 days after delivery.

2. Inspect the Container at Delivery

Check the container and seals immediately upon delivery.

If the container is damaged, or seals are missing, broken, or incorrect:

Note this clearly on the delivery receipt

Keep all damaged or irregular seals and locks

3. Document the Loss or Damage

If damage is visible at delivery:

Record it immediately on the delivery receipt

Keep all packing materials

Take clear photos of damaged items

If damage is discovered later:

Document it immediately upon discovery

Notify MSC with details, including missing items and estimated claim amount

Do not discard packing or damaged goods

4. Survey by Expert

Inform MSC immediately so a survey can be arranged

Allow access to the cargo and container for inspection

MSC will cover expert fees for suspected damage above USD 5,000

5. Submit a Complete Compensation Request

Within 30 days of delivery (or expected delivery for lost cargo), submit your claim and all supporting documents to MSC, including:

MSC Bill of Lading / Sea Waybill or contract of carriage

Commercial invoice

Packing list

Claim cover letter with itemized amounts (on company letterhead)

Delivery receipt showing any exceptions

Destruction certificate or salvage sale receipt (if applicable)

MSC may request additional documents if needed.

6. Where to Submit

Send all claims and documents to:

EPR.claims@msc.com

Or to your dedicated point of contact with the local agency.

What is the Difference Between Extended Protection and Cargo Insurance?

Although MSC Extended Protection service is not an insurance product, it provides an additional layer of security in the event of loss or damage to your cargo while under MSC’s care. As a premium service ancillary to our Bill of lading, MSC Extended Protection offers enhanced liability coverage by widening the carriage terms of the standard MSC bill of lading.

Can I Combine Marine Cargo Insurance and Extended Protection?

The Extended Protection services works perfectly alongside your existing cargo insurance solution. Extended Protection is the perfect addition to your marine insurance, and covers your deductible, making it a valuable investment.

Is the Extended Protection Services Available for Spot and Volume Shipments?

MSC Extended Protection is suitable for both types of shipments and all volumes.

Does MSC’s Cargo Protection Solutions Apply to all Cargo and Equipment Types?

Currently, MSC Extended Protection is available for shipments carried in dry and reefer containers (for frozen cargo only). If you have fresh cargo to protect, please check our dedicated solutions page.

Some cargo has a narrower scope of protection, classifying it as ‘Restricted Cargo’, either due to specific packing standards or risks. Other cargo is fully excluded from protection under our EPR Terms and Conditions. Please check our cargo exclusion list within our terms and conditions to verify if your shipment is eligible for our Extended Protection solution.

Why Partner with MSC?

At MSC, we believe that providing customers with peace of mind is a key part of our job. That is why we apply a personalized one-stop-shop approach to cargo insurance.

We team with trusted global insurance partners to deliver comprehensive cargo insurance coverage. All our policies are provided on a full cover (all risks ICC A terms) basis to protect you against the hazards inherent to maritime and inland transportation, and to secure full compensation in case of loss or damage to your cargo.

Our local offices will take care of the entire process for you.

Backed by first class insurance providers

Competitively priced and fully personalized

Wider coverage than the standard marine cargo insurance

Quick quotations and rapid claim resolutions

Protecting your Cargo Matters

Cargo transportation does not come without risks, and you need coverage beyond basic. Whether your goods are transported by land, or by air and at sea, we are here for you, and you can rest assured you are fully covered with MSC Cargo Insurance.

We understand the financial and emotional stress caused to businesses by cargo loss or damage, so we partnered with first-class providers to create for you a tailor-made insurance solution. Offering you the widest possible coverage for maritime and inland transportation to ease your mind and protect your supply chain.

We're Always on your Side

At MSC, we believe that providing customers with peace of mind is a key part of our job. Our flexible solutions are available for both spot shipments and volume contracts, and cargo insurance cost and coverage are tailored according to your needs, cargo and chosen mode of transportation, without any hidden costs.

Download our brochure

Comprehensive and Flexible Protection

Our cargo protection solutions support a broad range of transportation methods, including warehouse-to-warehouse and anything else in between. We also offer tailored solutions to enable you to select the appropriate coverage options for your unique cargo requirements. From competitive premiums to the handling of any eventual claim, you can rely on our local offices to make the process as quick and simple as possible.

Unique Solution for your Fresh Cargo

Our dedicated fresh cargo solution aims to provide a clear and simple pricing procedure where your tariff charge is based on your cargo value and specifications. Depending on the declared value of your cargo, you will receive a comprehensive quotation for the protection of your cargo with no hidden costs.

That's not all

Our services cover most transportation types almost anywhere in the world and with few restrictions as to the nature of the cargo.

We also provide end-to-end coverage for reefers and dry containers and project cargo with a high-value limit.

Applicable whether the loss or damage occurs in transit from port-to-port, warehouse-to-warehouse, or anywhere in between.

Available for both spot shipments and volume contracts. Cargo insurance cost and coverage are tailored to your needs.

What risks we cover

With a wider coverage than the standard terms of marine cargo insurance our solution includes loss or damage to cargo due to:

Fire

Stranding, grounding, sinking, collision

Salvage & general average contributions

Heavy weather events

Natural events (‘Act of God’)

Wetting damage (hole in the roof allowing water infiltration)

Physical damage to the cargo, stevedore mishandling

Thefts & pilferage

Reefer temperature variation

Destruction costs

Sue & labour

Cargo insurance coverage does not include loss or damage to cargo as a result of geopolitical events, packing issues, wilful misconduct of the assured, delay, ordinary leakage (loss in weight, wear and tear of the cargo) or inherent vice.

MSC Protection Solutions Do not Cover

Please be aware, that our cargo protection systems do not cover loss or damage to cargo due to:

● Geopolitical events (sanctioned countries; persons or goods; seizures or arrests; riots; strikes; warlike operations; terrorism; weapons; cyber-risks, and similar events)

● Delays

● Insufficient or improper packaging

● Loss or damage attributable to the wilful misconduct of the shipper, consignee, or other merchant

● Ordinary leakage, loss in weight, wear, and tear

● Inherent defect, quality, or vice

● Temperature or atmospheric pressure changes

Why should I buy MSC Cargo Insurance?

Transportation is not a risk-free process and major events such as rough weather, fire and other such occurrences could damage your cargo while in transit with us. Insurance will protect your cargo from these known risks, as and ensure you have the right to be compensated in case of damage related to these specific risks, as standard Bill of Lading clauses could potentially exclude or limit the carrier’s liability.

How do I get a quote?

Get an instant quote by sending your shipment details to our cargo insurance team at msccargoinsurance@msc.com or directly from your MSC local offices.

How will I be invoiced?

The premium for your insurance will be charged and manifested on your shipping invoice.

Who appoints the surveyor?

Once you notify, the insurance company of your cargo damage, it will appoint a local surveyor to establish the cause of damage and eventually to resolve your claim.

Which documents must I submit to have my claim processed?

All the documents you need to submit are listed on your certificate of insurance alongside the claims procedure. The main documents to be provided are the commercial invoice, a copy of the Bill of Lading, a letter of protest and the survey report.

How long does it take to get compensation in case of claim?

MSC applies a very efficient money back policy and your claim will be solved within 30 days.

Can I apply for MSC Cargo Insurance while the container is already in transit?

We can arrange insurance while the cargo is already in transit, but we reserve the right to investigate the circumstances first with our agent to ensure there is no damage before issuing the certificate of insurance.

MSC Thermal Liner Solution

Shipping Sensitive Cargo Safely

Designed to protect sensitive cargo from temperature, moisture and condensation changes or contamination that may cause damage to your products, thermal container liners are the ideal solution for many businesses.

Perfect for companies shipping cargo with a high moisture content, thermal liners help maintain a stable environment throughout transportation. As a result, you’ll be able to deliver high-quality products to your customers, at speed, every time.

When shipping sensitive cargo, we understand that precision and care are required. That’s why we developed our thermal liner solution to safeguard your cargo and offer you additional peace of mind.

Easy installation services

Supported by experts

Pre-installation option

Documentation support

Did you Know?

MSC thermal liner shipping solutions are ideal for shipping commodities including cocoa, coffee beans, soybeans, corn, dried fruit and nuts, salt, sugar, rice, pasta, and tobacco.

Discover MSC Thermal Liner Solution

Made from a blend of aluminium and polyethylene, our insulated container liners are specially designed to fit in a 20’ or 40’ container. Once installed, moisture absorbers are placed inside the thermal liners before the cargo is added to ensure that all moisture remnants are absorbed.

Weather Protection

Alongside maintaining a stable temperature, MSC’s thermal container liners also offer weather protection. By shielding your cargo from direct exposure to the elements and creating a consistent internal environment, your cargo is protected from any conditions that may impact its quality.

Did You Know? The temperature inside a container can fluctuate from -25°C to +60°C.

Reduced Condensation

During the vacuum sealing process of thermal liner installation, an ‘air gap’ is created between the container walls and your cargo. This lowers any potential condensation occurring during transportation, which in turn reduces the risk of moisture damaging your cargo while in transit.

Air Removal

Beyond this, MSC’s thermal container liners are also fitted with a special valve that is designed to remove the air between your cargo and our thermal liners. Particularly useful when shipping food or other sensitive goods, the removal of air helps eliminate moisture within the container and keeps your cargo fresh for longer.

Benefits of MSC Thermal Liner Solutions

Aside from protecting and preserving your cargo, there are numerous benefits to working with MSC for your thermal liner shipping solutions, including:

Easy installation services and remote removal solutions. As an additional service at MSC we can also deliver your container with the thermal liner pre-installed.

Additional safety when shipping self-heating commodities like charcoal. The reflective properties of our thermal container liners, combined with the reduction in oxygen, makes shipping your cargo safer.

Expert support. Not only do we specialize in keeping your cargo safe and stable, but with MSC you’ll be working with a dedicated team of local experts who will guide you every step of the way.

Because you Need More than
Ocean Shipping Services

MSC thermal liner solution can also be combined with our Extended Protection (EPR) solution. This provides you with competitive pricing, comprehensive cargo protection, and expedited processing from our specialized team.

Whether you’re shipping charcoal or cocoa, utilizing our thermal liner shipping solutions helps preserve and protect your cargo every step of the way. When working with MSC, you’ll be supported by our team of experts, dedicated to working tirelessly to find the best shipping solutions for your business.

Why Trust your Agricultural
Shipments to MSC?

Services Designed to Maximize Quality and Shelf-life

Agricultural produce, such as cashews, cocoa, coffee, rice and soy, requires meticulous care throughout its journey to preserve freshness, taste, texture and aroma.

MSC’s green, modern and efficient fleet enables us to safely handle, stow and transport a range of dry and food-grade cargo to keep your perishable produce in perfect condition throughout its entire journey.

Personalized Approach

We work hard to build productive relationships with our customers, taking the time to get to know your unique business and finding flexible solutions to meet your changing needs.

With more than 50 years of experience in shipping agricultural goods, we have built up the expertise needed to deliver the efficient and cost-effective shipping services.

Any Cargo, Any Location

Thanks to MSC’s outstanding global port coverage and connectivity, we can provide local support throughout your cargo’s journey and deliver cost-effective door-to-door solutions. You can also rest assured that our reliable and well-maintained equipment (standard, food-grade or even reefer) will be right there, when and where you need it.

Why Trust your Cashew Exports to MSC?

Global Network

Our global sea and inland network connects the main exporters
in West and East Africa to importers in Asia and beyond,
offering direct calls and frequent sailings.

Scalable Solutions

Depending on the region, cashew nuts usually have two peak production periods per year, each lasting four to five months.
To meet the demands of this complex annual cycle, MSC provides flexible logistics support that can be scaled up, scaled down
or paused as required.

Learn more

Professional Support

Every single cashew journey we organize for our customers receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our highly experienced teams take huge pride in supporting each step of the export process, from guiding customers through country-specific procedures,
to helpfully suggesting advice around container and shipment preparation.

“Over the past five decades, we’ve developed solid expertise in transporting cashews.”

Why Ship your Cocoa with MSC

Local Experts

To thrive in the booming cocoa market, local logistics expertise
is essential. Thanks to our worldwide presence, MSC has expert teams across all of the world’s main cocoa-producing countries, including Brazil, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Mexico, Cameroon, Ghana,
Ivory Coast and Nigeria.

Cocoa Know-how

Cocoa beans need to be shipped shortly after harvest, as extended storage can result in losses due to the high relative humidity in the tropics. With more than 50 years of experience in shipping cocoa, MSC can advise you on the best shipment options for your containerized cargo.

Facilitating International Trade

Through our global network, MSC connects cocoa-producing
countries to the world’s main trade centres. In line with our Company value ‘We believe in equal opportunities’, we are proud to play a role
in enabling local producers and exporters to reach new markets
and expand their business.

Because you Need More than Port-to-Port Services

Looking for extra storage, inland transportation or support with customs paperwork? We’ve got you covered.

Did you know?

Brazil is the world’s largest coffee producer, providing a third of the beans consumed worldwide.

Why Ship your Coffee with MSC

From Farm to Cup

The coffee-stuffing process requires a high level of care and precision, as well as the resources, equipment and flexibility to scale up during peak season. MSC works closely with exporters, brokers and importers during the annual coffee season to tailor its inland transportation and handling services, global shipping and shipment preparation services to meet each customer’s exact needs.

Read more

Global Reach for your Coffee Exports

Our presence across 155 countries, including the world’s top coffee producers, Brazil, Vietnam, Colombia, Indonesia and Ethiopia, ensures MSC is well placed to support the thriving coffee trade. We provide depots with dedicated stuffing areas for coffee, container pre-stacking facilities and a bonded area to speed up the customs clearance process.

Exporting Coffee Whether Arabica or Robusta

Every single coffee journey we organize for our customers receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our highly experienced teams take huge pride in supporting each step of the export process, from guiding customers through appropriate and country-specific procedures to advice around shipment preparation and compliance with local regulations.

Because you Need More than
Port-to-Port Shipping

Looking for extra storage, inland transportation or support with customs paperwork? We've got you covered.

Did you know?

Cotton is one of the world’s top five soft commodities.

Why Ship your Cotton with MSC

Customer Support

We take care to find the best possible transportation solution for each customer, leveraging our global sea and inland network. While your cotton is on the move, our dedicated team of local experts are available around the clock to answer questions on how to handle cotton while shipping and provide updates as needed.

Read more

Dedicated Trade Services

Our dedicated trade services from North and South America, Asia and Europe ensure that your cotton will be transported in the best condition. Thanks to our global logistics network and inland transportation services, you can choose from a complete range of shipment options. We will handle the full process from the time the cotton leaves the plantation to its point of export.

Flexible Transport Solutions

As cotton crops depend heavily on temperature and weather conditions, production volumes can fluctuate greatly from season to season. That’s why MSC specializes in scalable logistics solutions that can be adapted according to your production volumes and transactional needs – helping to make sure that none of your crop goes to waste.

We handle the entire process from the moment your cotton leaves the field to the moment it is delivered.

Because you Need more than
Port-to-Port Services

Our complete range of services makes cotton-shipping easy, with the support you need at every step for the best way to ship cotton.

Tailored to your Supply Chain

Kept in Perfect Condition

We understand the importance of preserving the quality of sesame seeds. Thanks to our experience in transporting food and dry cargo, your precious seeds are in safe hands throughout the journey, from the moment you book until the moment they reach the end customer. This includes dedicated warehousing and storage. We use food-grade units to extend the shelf-life of the seeds, so we can transport them over long distances without damaging their appearance, flavour or quality.

End-to-end Support

By combining our extensive multimodal network in Paraguay and Africa with our global port coverage we ensure the very best door-to-door service no matter where your sesame comes from. Our highly skilled teams of local experts guide you through the different shipment options and handle the entire process, from container stuffing to customs paperwork.

Experts in Transporting all Kinds of Sugar Around the World

Whether granulated, course or brown, we consume nearly 180 million metric tonnes of sugar in the world every year. But once it was a luxury. Refined sugar was extremely rare and often called ‘white gold’. Not any more! Thanks to its use as a sweetener, flavour enhancer and a source of energy, sugar has become a staple ingredient in what we eat and drink every day.

The global demand for sugar has never been greater. Sugar products, like molasses and sugar cane, require meticulous care on their journey through the supply chain in order to preserve freshness and taste. MSC is an experienced specialist sugar transporter with local experts in the major sugar producing territories.

We are present in 155 countries, including the world’s leading sugar producers. MSC’s outstanding global port coverage and connectivity means that we provide local support throughout your sugar’s entire journey to nearly any destination around the world. Our team of logistics experts will handle all your needs and we take great pride in our ability to help you every step of the way.

FAQs about Sugar

How Sugar Should be Shipped?

There are specialist measures for shipping sugar, which is a product highly sensitive to contamination. Sugar needs to be neither too dry or too wet during transportation.

Containers should be maintained at a relative humidity level of 80-85% . If sugar of any type starts to lose moisture caking can take place. Damaged sugar can be saved if refined locally. White sugar is mainly transported as breakbulk cargo in bags of woven natural material or woven plastic bags with a plastic inner bag impermeable to water.

Which countries produce the most sugar?

How long does it take to grow sugar?

It can take 12-18 months for sugar cane to mature fully in the field before it can be harvested.

What are sugar molasses?

In the 16th century, the Spanish introduced sugar cane to America. Some inhabitants of the region discovered that after extracting the sugar from the canes, a thick liquid remained: the molasses. Today molasses is used to prepare endless delicious dishes, desserts and drinks.

Overview

how it works

Why Trust your Car Shipments to MSC?

Wider Port Coverage

For your new car's delivery, our fleet of vessels ensures you can reach smaller, more local ports anywhere in the world. Not only does this allow you to expand your customer base but also means you can enjoy a greater choice of delivery points. This, combined with less unnecessary inland transport, and fewer transshipments helps make your overall supply chain faster and more efficient.

Faster and more Reliable Transit

Our capacity and global network allows us to offer you the widest routes selection and most frequent ocean services available for your new car transportation needs. As a business, you’ll benefit from weekly sailings, helping to provide quicker transit times and ensuring timely delivery to your customers.

Premium Level of Care

When it comes to considering the ‘best way to move a car’, we meticulously handle every shipment, providing thorough car inspections, precise loading and lashing of vehicles and careful unloading.

To ensure stability and protect your valuable new car from vibrations during transit, each vehicle is securely fastened inside our containers using advanced lashing techniques. It’s this attention to detail that helps significantly reduce the risk of scratches and accidents and means that your vehicles are transported with the highest level of precision and care.

Experience and Expertise

All our new car shipping processes are designed around your car production timetables and handling specifications to provide your business with the tailor-made solutions you need. Beyond this, you’ll be working with a global network of dedicated experts who are with you at every step. From car collection at origin to final delivery at destination, we will work with you to optimize your new car transportation supply chain so you can focus on delivering the very best to your customers.

Get into the Fast Lane with MSC

At MSC we combine our unmatched commitment to the safe and reliable delivery of automotive shipping with 50 years of experience and expertise (and an excellent damage record) to ensure your new car shipping supply chain is as smooth as possible. We are committed to keeping you on the road to success and miles ahead of your competition.

How Shipping New Cars with MSC Works

We leverage our expertise in container logistics to offer reliable and efficient car transportation solutions for automotive customers. Our strict quality protocols for containerized car transport ensure the utmost care and precision in vehicle transportation, offering Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) unparalleled peace of mind.

In loading, each new car is securely fastened using advanced lashings which ensure stability and shield your cargo from vibrations during handling. Containers protect cars from external elements such as rain, hail, saltwater, and sand, while our meticulous approach significantly reduces the risk of scratches and accidents. With the highest level of care, our experts ensure that your valuable assets travel securely to their destination and arrive in flawless condition.

Results

Load more

Car Prep and Inspections

As soon as your car shipment arrives at the MSC Depot or storage space, a comprehensive survey is performed to ensure the vehicles are prepped for stuffing.

Stuffing, Lashing and Loading

Following the inspection, vehicles are being securely stuffed and lashed in the container with extreme care and then transported to the terminal to be loaded on the vessel.

Delivery and Collection

Upon vessel arrival, the container will be transported to the MSC Depot where the cars will be meticulously unlashed and destuffed. To ensure your car shipment is ready to be collected a thorough survey will be conducted.
